playbookOutputs: Nil VAT201 submitted on eFiling for the tax period
playbookCommonFailures: Bank statements or invoices show sales or purchases in the period, so a nil return would be false
Wrong tax period — the vendor is on a 2-monthly (Category A/B) cycle and the client named a single month
VAT number not linked to the eFiling profile used
Nil returns filed for several consecutive periods trigger a SARS VAT deregistration/verification query

informationToProvide.label: Company Name & 10-Digit SARS VAT Registration Number (4...)
informationToProvide.helpText: Registered company name and 10-digit SARS VAT reference number (starting with 4).
informationToProvide.aiHint: Company name and 10-digit SARS VAT registration number.

informationToProvide.label: VAT Tax Period (YYYY-MM) & Written Confirmation of Nil VAT Activity
informationToProvide.helpText: Specify the VAT period (e.g., 2026-08) and confirm in writing that no taxable supplies or input VAT claims occurred.
informationToProvide.aiHint: VAT201 period (YYYY-MM) and written confirmation of zero output and input VAT.

informationToProvide.label: SARS eFiling Username
informationToProvide.helpText: Your SARS eFiling login username (or confirm if My Accountant already has Registered Representative / Tax Practitioner shared access).
informationToProvide.aiHint: SARS eFiling username for the taxpayer profile or confirmation of shared Tax Practitioner access.

informationToProvide.label: SARS eFiling Password
informationToProvide.helpText: Encrypted and restricted to authorized filing staff and the SARS eFiling automation worker.

informationToProvide.label: SARS eFiling OTP Required? (Yes / No)
informationToProvide.helpText: Does logging into your SARS eFiling profile trigger a One-Time PIN (OTP) to your cellphone or email?
informationToProvide.aiHint: Whether 2FA OTP relay is required when logging into SARS eFiling.

informationToProvide.label: Best Time to Contact for SARS OTP
informationToProvide.helpText: Select a date and time window when you will be available to relay the real-time SARS OTP within the 10-minute eFiling timeout.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Preferred date/time window to coordinate real-time SARS eFiling OTP relay.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Collect eFiling access and nil confirmation
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Credentials on file, period identified and client has confirmed in writing that the return is nil
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Ask for the eFiling username/password and confirm which period the VAT201 is for. Get an explicit written confirmation in Communication History that no taxable supplies were made and no input VAT is being claimed for the whole tax period. Do not promise a turnaround shorter than 1–2 working days.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Verify period and that a nil return is appropriate
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Return is outstanding on eFiling for that period and nothing on file contradicts the nil declaration
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Confirm the VAT201 for the period is issued under Returns → VAT201 and check the vendor's tax period category (A/B = 2-monthly, C = monthly, D/E = 6-/12-monthly). The period must match the category. If evidence contradicts a nil return (e.g. a bank statement with sales deposits or tax invoices dated in the period), stop and raise a proposal to switch to the trading version of this service.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Submit the nil VAT201 on eFiling
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: VAT201 shows status Filed/Submitted for the period and the confirmation is saved
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Returns → VAT201 → select the tax period. All fields (1–20) zero; total VAT payable/refundable = 0. Check the "Diesel" and "Import" fields are not pre-populated by SARS from customs data. Stage with a screenshot of the completed return for Kevin's approval before Submit. eFiling login from a new device/IP triggers an OTP to the taxpayer's registered cell/email: pause, raise an otpRequest on the portal job via the OTP relay (Kevin, or the client through the Communication History link if allowed), 10-minute timeout then fail cleanly and reschedule. Never store OTPs. If a CAPTCHA appears, fall back to hand-off mode with the handoff sheet. Prefer filing from our practitioner profile if the taxpayer is already linked as a client; otherwise use the client's own login. If the taxpayer is not registered for the tax type on eFiling, stop and raise a proposal — do not activate tax types without Kevin.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Deliver proof of submission
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Submission confirmation / filed return PDF posted to Communication History
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Post the filed VAT201. Explain in plain English that the nil return had to be filed by the 25th (manual) / last business day (eFiling) of the month after the period and that consecutive nil returns may prompt SARS to ask whether the vendor should stay registered. ⚠ verify due-date wording.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Final sign-off
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Kevin confirms the order can be completed
